from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RightOfUseAssetEntry(BaseModel):
    """A right-of-use asset figure from a company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name this report belongs to")
    asset_value: float | None = Field(description="The right-of-use asset amount")
    period_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is period-end or period-start value, e.g., '期末', '期初'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    right_of_use_assets: list[RightOfUseAssetEntry]
